title: Complete pinned DesktopBridge leaf-method audit
scope: 121 interface leaf methods, production web and shared client-runtime typed references, plus manual bounded dynamic CLI indexing. Browser-only methods outside DesktopBridge are adjacent obligations rather than denominator members.
limitations: Source-level audit, no new runtime tests executed. Integrated native methods have prior bounded macOS evidence only.
Method enumeration is exhaustive for the pinned DesktopBridge and DesktopPreviewBridge interfaces; runtime dynamic/reflection and external applications are not statically enumerable.
Fork-owned distribution/cloud missing means ownership/implementation work is required; it is not permission to omit the upstream workflow.
Project-icon increment is unmerged/in progress in working tree at snapshot; do not promote it based on this artifact.
Raw source tree is an extracted pinned archive, not a git checkout; source contract hash is recorded.
Browser/shared host equivalence is partial workflow evidence, never certification of native feature parity.

groups.title: Existing scoped local dialogs and HTTP(S) opener
groups.notes: Managed apiVersion1 implements these two contracts on macOS with authenticated origin/generation/window ACL and native QA. Other target OSs remain open.

groups.title: Durable app identity, preferences, catalog and primary attachment
groups.notes: Browser/HTTP equivalents exist, but do not certify native desktop metadata, app-owned encrypted catalog or preferences stable across host port/origin changes. Native attachment already authenticates through fragment+HTTP rather than these Electron methods.

groups.title: File context, theme import, native menus and clipboard
groups.notes: Restore explicit capability-specific routes without injecting a partial desktopBridge. Preserve browser inputs/DOM menus/fetch and genuine Electron behavior. Never add arbitrary renderer-supplied file read/clipboard powers.

groups.title: Windows, lifecycle, native attention and input integration
groups.notes: Native window/menu/quit/gesture/badge behavior is absent from the managed web bridge. Browser equivalents cover portions only; multiple windows require unique grants and durable routing, not reused labels.

groups.title: Provider callbacks, OS web links and app/CLI activation
groups.notes: Manual redirect paste and ordinary in-app links remain; native provider callback capture, external OS links and CLI/project activation are not wired to managed content. Fork-owned protocol and state/nonce validation required.

groups.title: SSH discovery, provisioning, authentication and reconnect
groups.notes: Desktop SSH gateway is explicitly unsupported without desktopBridge. Existing browser direct HTTP/relay connections do not provision SSH processes or tunnels. Keep credentials native, bind descriptor identity before forwarding tokens and clean up only owned resources.

groups.title: Local host exposure, tailnet and WSL lifecycle controls
groups.notes: These settings alter the backend spawned by this desktop. Managed host is loopback-only and does not inherit Electron supervisor/Tailscale/WSL controls. Implement independent Blackcrab process/network ownership and enforce host scopes; Windows WSL is a target-specific obligation.

groups.title: Snap Shot permissions, shortcuts, capture delivery and recovery
groups.notes: Managed content receives no Snap Shot bridge. Requires native permissions, global shortcut lifecycle, staged config conflict checks, durable pending capture/ack semantics, optional accessibility text, scoped routing and cancellation.

groups.title: Independent branding, telemetry policy, signed updates and CLI installation
groups.notes: Cannot call upstream Electron update/download/CLI/cloud infrastructure as Blackcrab distribution. Need independent branding, endpoints/trust keys, staged updates/rollback and owned CLI path. Existing Tauri updater registration is not managed client integration.

groups.title: Native local browser surface, navigation, isolation and profiles
groups.notes: Electron webview guest/partition and native browser lifecycle are not provided by Tauri shell. Shared server-browser streaming supplies some operations but is a different renderer with explicit browser capabilities and dependencies; do not certify local native browser parity from source reuse.

groups.title: Preview annotation, screenshot, recording, artifacts and native popout
groups.notes: Managed client has previewBridge=null; native capture/annotation/recording controls are hidden. Need hosted guest capture/input channels, permission/focus/cancellation, bounded artifact registry, safe reveal/copy, recording start/stop/save and cleanup, native PiP lifecycle.

adjacentObligations.workflow: Actual native notifications and click routing
adjacentObligations.gap: Uses browser Notification constructor/permission, not DesktopBridge. A native badge adapter alone cannot implement notifications, permission denial or click-to-thread behavior in WK.

adjacentObligations.workflow: Secure app-owned browser state across managed host port changes
adjacentObligations.gap: IndexedDB/localStorage follow the origin; random managed port changes require explicit native persistence/migration and security handling.
isElectron=false intentionally; adapt capability-specific call sites and UI, never fake desktopBridge or globally declare Electron.

adjacentObligations.workflow: Fork-owned browser/app branding and public links
adjacentObligations.gap: Fallback branding is T3 Code Beta and desktop downloads point to t3.codes/download. Blackcrab build must own branding/public links without removing source attribution.
